entries.preservation: Preserve the existing scalar when MAINFRAME has not previously owned it; require explicit adoption before replacement.
entries.uninstall: Remove only an unchanged MAINFRAME-owned value and restore the captured predecessor when available.

entries.purpose: Register the MAINFRAME PostToolUse bridge entry.
entries.preservation: Preserve all nonmatching user entries and their order.
entries.uninstall: Remove only the unchanged entry selected by mainframe:PostToolUse.

entries.purpose: Configure only the catalogued MAINFRAME Context7 server.
entries.preservation: Preserve every other MCP server and reject a conflicting user-owned entry of the same name.
entries.uninstall: Remove only an unchanged MAINFRAME-owned mainframe-context7 map entry.
